task.title: Reset Your AuditX Password
task.shortdesc: If you are new to AuditX or have forgotten your password, follow these steps to create or reset your password using the automated email link.

ul.li: You must have received a system assignment from the AuditX administration team
Access to the email account registered with your AuditX account
A web browser to access the AuditX Forge portal

step.cmd: Check your email inbox for an automated password reset message from noreply@visailabs.com

info.note: If the email does not appear in your inbox, check your spam or junk folder, as automated system emails may be filtered.

step.cmd: Open the email and locate the "Reset Password" button
step.info: The button is prominently displayed in the email message body.

step.cmd: Click the "Reset Password" button to access the password creation form
step.info: You will be redirected to a secure page in your web browser.

step.cmd: Enter your new password in the provided field

ul.li: Use a strong password with mixed case letters, numbers, and special characters
Ensure the password is at least 8 characters long

step.cmd: Confirm your new password by re-entering it in the confirmation field
Click the "Confirm" button to complete the password reset
step.info: You will see a confirmation message indicating successful password reset.

step.cmd: Navigate to the AuditX Forge login page and enter your credentials

ul.li: Password: The new password you just created

result.p: You have successfully reset your password and can now access the AuditX Forge portal with your new credentials.

ul.li: Proceed to set up your first site (Site Creation)
Create user accounts for your team
T+0 minutes: System sends automated password reset email
T+5 minutes: Check inbox (or junk folder)
T+10 minutes: Click reset link and create password
T+15 minutes: Log in to Forge and begin setup

dlentry.dd: Check spam/junk folder. Wait 5-10 minutes and refresh inbox. Contact support if email does not arrive within 15 minutes.
Password reset links are valid for 24 hours. Request a new password reset email from the login page.
Ensure your password contains uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, and is at least 8 characters long.
